title: Repeated Paragraph Type Seed
source_note: Manual seed: A./A. and Q./Q. with no colloquy must flag; Q./colloquy/Q. and A./colloquy/A. must not. Accept is review-only (no text rewrite). Gutters aligned.

entries.text: Q. Do you remember the date of the meeting?

entries.text: A. Yes. It was in March.
